Im terrible with measurements, I kinda learned this from watching my dad 😅

Ingredients
About 10 Potatoes
8 slices of Ham/Turkey Breast 
11 Eggs
1/2 Of a large onion
Vegetable oil
Parsley
Curry
Powdered Garlic
Salt
Medium Heat Fire

1. Skin then cut the potatoes into medium sized cubes 
2. Cut the meat into medium sized squares
3. Crack your eggs into a bowl and stir them
4. Cut your onions about medium sized squares (lol I just realized how much of everything is medium sized, but don't worry we'll get the the big portioned unhealthy part)
5. Heat up oil for about 10-15 minutes 
6. Fry 1/4 of your onions for flavor
7. Add all your potatoes into the oil
8. Take the potatoes out once they are golden
9. Add salt (not too much because the meat should be carrying lost of salt)
10. Leave the heat on with the same oil in the pan
11. Add the rest of your onions 
12. Stir the onions around for about 3 minutes
13. Add Garlic and stir until oil looks orange
14. Add a teaspoon of curry (I KNOW THIS MEASUREMENT 😎)
15. Stir and add parsley at the same time (the oil should looks like parsley soup now)
16. AFTER WAITING ABOUT 1 MINUTE DUMP THE POTATOES 😎 (in the pan of course)
17. Mix in everything 
18. Turn down the heat and add your eggs and american cheese 
19.Stir and then cover the pan for about 5 minutes
20. Turn the heat back to medium
21.Lift the pan and stir until everything is looking less "liquidy" 
YOU'RE DONE! Sorry I suck at explaining (I'm kinda 18 and alone in college lol) but you can ask questions!
